comment: Claude Code rendering map: how each tool named in policy.json reaches a Claude
Code session. Peer of render.cursor.json. policy.json (the IDE-neutral ownership
authority) never changes for this adapter.
Claude Code has no editor-formatter-extension surface of its own: on Web and Mobile
the .vscode/ rendering never survives a clone. So formatter ownership reaches a
Claude Code session through the agentdocs adapter's managed block in CLAUDE.md,
which IS git-tracked. That is recorded here as ownership_carrier so there is exactly
one place ownership is rendered for Claude Code and no second source to drift.
Tools whose policy authority is 'repo' are carried the same way but bound nowhere.

ownership_carrier.note: The formatter-ownership block in CLAUDE.md is the only ownership carrier that survives a clone into a Claude Code Web/Mobile sandbox.

installer.note: ONE installer for every surface. Surface entrypoints are thin callers that do only what their surface uniquely needs, then delegate. Adapter wiring belongs in install.sh, never in a caller.
installer.dependency_policy: uv.lock is the sole source of interpreter and dependency versions; applied via the ops/scripts/ensure_uv_environment.sh wrapper. No adapter file re-declares a pin.

skills.web_mobile: referenced from the governance clone created by web/setup.sh

mcp.cli: user-scope MCP server via `claude mcp add-json`

biome.note: Rendered as a CLAUDE.md ownership statement, not an editor.defaultFormatter key.

vscode-json.note: JSONC only. Cursor binds vscode.json-language-features; Biome's editor extension cannot format jsonc.

ruff.note: Rendered as a CLAUDE.md ownership statement, not an editor.defaultFormatter key.

eslint.note: policy authority is 'repo' — carried for reference, bound nowhere.
